checks.result: Any recorded fact, verification or hypothesis error returns nil report. Skipped dependent hypotheses can only be reached after a recorded invalid-fact error; no partial report can be accepted.
Fact resolution and verification still bind to exact trace evidence and known tool types. Followup proposals remain ineligible as tool_plan verification sources or measurement facts.

Every single feedback is revalidated against fixed reasons/sections/field names/tool/unit enums. No candidate value, arbitrary path, report text, observation body, domain.Message or err.Error is echoed. One unsafe item falls back to generic failure.

Original input maxima remain 24 facts, 4 hypotheses and 3 verification requests. Feedback collects at most one error per entry, rotates the three sections, serializes complete JSON items only, caps at 6 items and 3500 UTF8 bytes, and marks truncation. SDK 4096 limit unchanged.
Finish still accepts only an error-free valid result; failure persists nil accepted result. Final-format gating and original model/tool budgets are unchanged.
Ordinary hotspot percent remains 0..100. The only wider CPU range requires RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT read_profile_summary /resources fixed path plus the strict resource provenance/schema/units/count helper.

limits: Read-only review only; meaningful unit/SDK regressions belong to the implementing agents and release verification.
No claim that bounded feedback guarantees model compliance, semantic correctness, causality or final live acceptance.
